import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_FILE = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train/train.json")
TEST_FILE = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test/test.json")
SAMPLE_SUB = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sampleSubmission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_json(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_json(TEST_FILE)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB)

target_col = "requester_received_pizza"
id_col = "request_id"

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Define retrieval columns (exist in train, fill test with train stats)
retrieval_cols = [
    "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_retrieval",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_retrieval",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_retrieval",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_retrieval",
]

# Pre-compute medians from train for consistent filling
retrieval_meds = {}
for col in retrieval_cols:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        retrieval_meds[col] = train_df[col].median()

# Fill test retrieval columns with train medians
for col, med in retrieval_meds.items():
    if col in test_df.columns:
        test_df[col] = med

# Build comprehensive numeric features list
numeric_base = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
] + retrieval_cols

# Text features - now including word-level info
text_features = ["request_title", "request_text_edit_aware"]

# Subreddit list feature
subreddit_list = ["requester_subreddits_at_request"]


def add_text_features(df, col, prefix=""):
    """Add multiple word-level text features."""
    df[prefix + "words_count"] = (
        df[col]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .apply(lambda x: len(x.split()) if isinstance(x, str) else 0)
    )
    df[prefix + "words_avg_len"] = (
        df[col]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .apply(
            lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in x.split()]) if len(x.split()) > 0 else 0
        )
    )
    return df


for tc in text_features:
    add_text_features(train_df, tc, f"{tc}_")
    add_text_features(test_df, tc, f"{tc}_")

if "requester_subreddits_at_request" in train_df.columns:
    sub_count_name = "subreddits_count"
    train_df[sub_count_name] = train_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
        lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
    )
    test_df[sub_count_name] = test_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
        lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
    )

# ========== CONSISTENT FEATURE ENGINEERING ==========
feature_candidates = []
for col in numeric_base + text_features + subreddit_list:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        # Get base name
        base = col.replace("_at_request", "").replace("_at_retrieval", "")
        base = base.replace("requester_", "").replace("request_", "")

        # Add various transformations
        feature_candidates.append(base + "_num")  # Original numeric

        # Time features
        if "time" in base.lower() or "age" in base.lower():
            feature_candidates.append(base + "_dayofweek")

        # Engagement features
        if any(w in base.lower() for w in ["upvote", "downvote", "comment", "post"]):
            feature_candidates.append(base + "_ratio")

# ========== INTERACTION FEATURES ==========
engagement = [
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
]

time_feat = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

for eng in engagement:
    if eng in train_df.columns:
        for tim in time_feat:
            if tim in train_df.columns:
                train_df[eng + "_" + tim + "_ratio"] = train_df[eng].fillna(0).astype(
                    float
                ) / (train_df[tim].fillna(1).astype(float) + 1)
                test_df[eng + "_" + tim + "_ratio"] = test_df[eng].fillna(0).astype(
                    float
                ) / (test_df[tim].fillna(1).astype(float) + 1)

# ========== BUILD FINAL FEATURE MATRIX ==========
all_feature_cols = []
for col in train_df.columns:
    if col == target_col or col == id_col:
        continue
    if col.startswith("request_title_") or col.startswith("request_text_edit_aware_"):
        if col not in all_feature_cols:
            all_feature_cols.append(col)
    elif col in text_features or col in numeric_base:
        if col not in all_feature_cols:
            all_feature_cols.append(col)
    elif "_ratio" in col or "_count" in col or "_len" in col:
        if col not in all_feature_cols:
            all_feature_cols.append(col)

# Ensure all feature columns exist in test
all_feature_cols = [c for c in all_feature_cols if c in train_df.columns]
all_feature_cols = sorted(all_feature_cols)

X_train_raw = train_df[all_feature_cols].copy()
y = train_df[target_col].copy().astype(int)
X_test_raw = test_df[all_feature_cols].copy()

print(f"Total features: {len(all_feature_cols)}")

# Handle missing values consistently
for col in all_feature_cols:
    nan_tr = X_train_raw[col].isna().sum()
    if nan_tr > 0:
        X_train_raw[col] = X_train_raw[col].fillna(
            X_train_raw[col].median(numeric_only=True)
        )
    X_test_raw[col] = X_test_raw[col].fillna(X_train_raw[col].median(numeric_only=True))

# Convert to float
X_train_final = X_train_raw.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
X_test_final = X_test_raw.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# ========== VALIDATION SPLIT ==========
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_final, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_tr)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")

# ========== MODEL TRAINING & EVALUATION ==========
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=-1,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_pred = np.clip(val_pred, 0, 1)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# ========== TEST PREDICTIONS ==========
test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]
test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 0, 1)

# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df[id_col], "requester_received_pizza": test_pred}
)
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
